messages:
Ina Gomez: hi everyone! Ina here — joining Growth as a PM today. I'm based in Oakland but plan to be in the SF office most Thursdays. fun fact: i collect novelty boba cups and will happily trade stickers for snacks. any tips for best places to park a bicycle + where to stash a boba cup on a hot day? :boba:
WelcomeBot: welcome to Redwood, Ina! :wave: See the #new-hires playbook for commute tips and the office map. you'll also get an invite to the welcome lunch.
Kai N: welcome Ina!! we have bike racks around the loading dock, and a small indoor bike room (key fob access) if you need overnight storage. email eng-ops for access and they'll hook you up.
Sage: hi Ina — welcome! there is a mini-fridge in the lounge you can stash drinks in (label with name). we also have an ice bucket near the espresso machine for emergency boba cooling. :droplet:
Ina Gomez: omg an ice bucket?! amazing. will definitely label. any sticker-trade etiquette? i'm low-key competitive about Good Sticker Trades.
Mira Patel: welcome! i'm infra but also self-appointed sticker referee. bring your best 1:1 trade and i'll vote. also FYI we do a casual rooftop meetup Thursdays at 5pm — good spot to show off cups and meet folks.
Kai N: if you cycle in we also have a small toolkit by the bike room for quick fixes. and free helmets in the lost-and-found sometimes (only slightly suspicious smells).
Ina Gomez: love it. thanks for the warm welcome. i'll bring a spare boba cup for the rooftop meetup and maybe some bubble tea coupons for the lunch. see you Thursday! :sparkles:
Sage: welcome aboard! low-stakes sticker swap and boba coupons = instant friend-making strategy. :tada:
Ina Gomez: onboarding admin q: who should i ping to get access to the SF parking permits page?
